name: reminder_scheduler
description: Creates, lists and deletes scheduled reminders and notifications

chat_id.description: Target chat id. If omitted, agent may inject current chat id automatically

prompt.description: Additional instructions to LLM from user if provided when reminder triggers

notify_text.description: Optional user-facing preface shown before LLM answer

schedule_type.description: Schedule type: once, interval, daily, cron

once_at.description: ISO datetime for one-time reminder, for example 2026-03-20T09:00:00+05:00

interval_seconds.description: Repeat interval in seconds for schedule_type=interval

time_of_day.description: Daily time in HH:MM for schedule_type=daily

cron_expr.description: Cron expression for schedule_type=cron, for example */15 * * * *

max_runs.description: Optional max number of runs for repeating reminders

active_only.description: For list action: include only active reminders
